source_caption_text:
She had no business going this hard 😭🔥

Being the lone female feature coming in at the end on that lineup and walking away with the best verse is too iconic. The remix already had YG, Lil Wayne, Rich Homie Quan, and Meek Mill, so by the time Nicki Minaj comes in near the end, the song has already gone through some heavy hitters. Then Nicki completely changes the energy with her animated delivery and rapid-fire flow.

Nicki’s verse stands out because she doesn’t try to blend into the track. She comes in with the same confidence and aggression she brought to her biggest records, throwing out punchlines and making the most of every second she gets. Her “female Weezy” line also hits differently considering Lil Wayne is on the remix, giving the verse a clear nod to the person who played such a major role in her career.

That’s what makes the verse so memorable all these years later. Nicki was the final feature on a stacked remix, but instead of feeling like an extra addition, she made the ending feel like her moment. Coming in last and still leaving people talking about your verse is a different level of presence.
